lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It is six o'clock in the evening. Liu Tao comes home.
lines.chinese: 现在是晚上六点。刘涛回到家。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: His parents are cooking dinner in the kitchen.
lines.chinese: 他的父母正在厨房做晚饭。

lines.speaker: Mrs Liu
lines.english: No, I'm not. I'm washing some vegetables.
lines.chinese: 不，我没有。我正在洗一些蔬菜。

lines.speaker: Mrs Liu
lines.english: I want to cook some tomato soup.

lines.speaker: Mr Liu
lines.english: I'm cooking meat with potatoes, Taotao.
lines.chinese: 涛涛，我正在做土豆烧肉。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.chinese: 太好了！爸爸，我等不及了！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Liu Tao is looking for some juice in the fridge.
lines.chinese: 刘涛正在冰箱里找一些果汁。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: Is there any apple juice in the fridge?

lines.speaker: Mrs Liu
lines.english: No, but there's some orange juice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Dinner is ready. Liu Tao is eating the meat.
lines.chinese: 晚饭准备好了。刘涛正在吃肉。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: It's yummy, Dad. I love it! You're a great cook!
lines.chinese: 很好吃，爸爸。我喜欢！你是个很棒的厨师！

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: It's nice, Mum. I love it too!
